facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

assets.label: export transfer pumps
assets.service: tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family

control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: danger tagging failure on P-7112

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-7112 and M-7112 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-7112 and M-7112 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-7112 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 25 December 2007 an incident occurred on P-7112 and M-7112 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
